text:
ana-docs: quick note  opened PR to update the Console observability quick examples. Found old field names (`trace_key`) in the dashboard snippet and a broken presets link. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9337
mike-eng: thanks. prefer we replace inline with the new shape `traceId` + `estimated_cost_usd` and add a 1-line migration note for legacy integrators.
sara-ml: runtime now emits `traceId` and nests cost under `estimated_cost_usd` in telemetry.v1; callout in docs is good.
luisa-sdk: i'll update Node + Python snippets. Proposed Node example:
```js
// attach trace id to tracehook
tracehook.record({ traceId: payload.traceId, estimated_cost_usd: payload.estimated_cost_usd })
```
Python mirrors with snake_case keys.
tara-ux: UI text: change image caption from "Cost by tracekey" to exactly "Cost by trace ID" and update alt text. Keep caption short.
link-bot: link-check: presets anchor -> 404, snippet reference -> 200.
nana-docs: (typo) sorry, pushing commit now: replaced fields, swapped out presets anchor with canonical presets URL, updated caption + alt text, added migration note explaining `trace_key -> traceId`.
mike-eng: pushed a tiny patch to the Go snippet to match struct names (EstimatedCostUSD).
luisa-sdk: pushed SDK examples to the branch as follow-up commit. Kept examples minimal and tested locally.
link-bot: CI checks for PR #9337: links: all passed.
nana-docs: merged. if anyone wants to mirror this change into older guides or the quickstart examples, please file a follow-up. :thumbsup:
